# Example of input validation and sanitization
def sanitize_input(input)
  ActionController::Base.helpers.sanitize(input)
end

# Usage in a controller action
def add
  product_name = sanitize_input(params[:name])
  product_data = sanitize_input(params[:data].to_json)

  product = Product.new(name: product_name, data: product_data)
  if product.save
    render json: { message: 'Product successfully added' }, status: :created
